newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westpac says in $225 mln Korea Zinc funding.
newsitem.headline: Westpac says in $225 mln Korea Zinc funding.

text.p: Korea Zinc Co Ltd has appointed Westpac Banking Corp, Dresdner Australia Ltd and Korea Exchange Bank Ltd as lead arrangers for a US$225 million project finance facility to partly finance a zinc refinery in Australia, Westpac said.
The funding is for development of a 170,000 tonne zinc refinery at Townsville, Queensland, by Korea Zinc's Australian subsidiary, Sun Metals Corp Pty Ltd, Westpac said.
Documentation and final due diligence is under way with construction start-up scheduled for mid-year, it said.

Citicorp International Ltd and Korea Long Term Credit Bank have also been mandated by Korea Zinc to arrange a $120 million subordinated unsecured floating rate note issue and associated guarantee facility on behalf of Sun Metals, guaranteed by Korea Zinc, it said.
Westpac said the refinery is only the first stage of what ultimately will be a $1 billion facility to be progressively constructed over the next decade.
This would be Korea Zinc's first major international capital raising, it added.
